title: The Family Guide to Home Security
summary: The best security cameras for families balance smart alerts, easy setup, and reliable coverage.
body_markdown:
Many Arlo cameras work great without a subscription. But if you’re looking for the ultimate, comprehensive, and hassle-free security package, then you need Arlo Secure.


With Arlo Secure, you don’t have to worry about manually managing your security feeds. Our Early Warning System can detect people, vehicles, fires, noises, and even customized activities, and alert you if and when they show up on camera. Then, Arlo Summary analyzes the past 24 hours on your feed and sends you a report of everything it spotted or a simple “All clear” message if nothing happened. It’s peace of mind made easy.


Need even more coverage for your family? Upgrading to Arlo Smart Secure provides access to our powerful Emergency Response package, which includes robust Threat Assessment tools alongside human-powered 24/7 Professional Monitoring and 24/7 Emergency Response.


Arlo Secure makes it easy to keep your family safe.[Sign up today](https://us.arlo.com/pages/arlo-secure) , or check out a free 30-Day trial with the purchase of any of our cameras, and see for yourself.
